description: stdshell/v1 — Runs a user-supplied script carried INLINE in the resource spec, under a configurable interpreter (bash by default). The worker (bin/stdworker, internal/providers/stdshell) writes spec.script to a temp file, runs `<interpreter> [args…] <script>` with the task's context + timeout, captures stdout/stderr, and records the exit result as status. exit 0 = success; exit 2 = terminal (no retry); any other non-zero = transient (retried up to max_transient_attempts); a ctx timeout/cancel is transient. Defaults (interpreter, baseline env, timeout) come from the kind's providerconfig; a resource spec overrides them.

script.description: The script text to run, inline (executed by the interpreter).

interpreter.description: Interpreter to run the script under (path or PATH name). Default: the kind config's default_interpreter, else bash.

args.description: Extra arguments passed to the interpreter before the script path.

env.description: Extra environment variables (KEY->VALUE) for the script.

timeout_seconds.description: Per-run timeout in seconds (0 = the kind config default, then no provider timeout; the task deadline still applies).

exit_code.description: The script's process exit code (0 on success).

default_interpreter.description: Interpreter used when a resource spec sets none (default bash).

env.description: Baseline environment variables (KEY->VALUE) for every script of this kind.

default_timeout_seconds.description: Per-run timeout used when a resource sets none (0 = none; the task deadline still applies).
